coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 as plotted on Fig. 7 y-axis (DFSZ-like C_agamma ≈ 0.75 assumed by authors)
notes: Paper reports a NEW measured 95% CL upper limit on DM decay rate (Fig. 4) from eROSITA eFEDS data over m_chi = 1.8-18 keV, converted by the authors into sterile-neutrino mixing (sin^2 2theta) and ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (Fig. 7). The pre-analysis hint of DarkPhoton is incorrect: the paper constrains sterile neutrinos and axion-like particles; I chose AxionPhoton as the coupling type since g_agamma [GeV^-1] appears on the exclusion plot. No numerical table is given; the data_points are approximate values reconstructed from the paper's decay-rate limit (Gamma ~ 1e-29 to 1e-27 s^-1, divided by 2 for the two-photon ALP decay) using the paper's eq. 10 normalization and g = alpha*C_agamma/(2*pi*f_a) with C_agamma = 0.75 (DFSZ-like), consistent with the Fig. 7 axis range (1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1). Values should be treated as order-of-magnitude accurate (~factor 2). NFW profile with rho_sun = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed; profile choice changes results by ~factor 2. Paper also presents PROJECTED sensitivities for eROSITA MW-center and all-sky surveys (not included in data_points). Regions at m_chi ~ 3-6 keV exceed 2-sigma MC containment due to effective-area calibration issues and are excluded by the authors. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 0, 2, 0, 0.6, 50)) | Vision: Traced the gold 'eFEDS limit (this work)' curve in Fig. 7 (ALP decay a->2gamma X-ray line search).
